event_records.description: Ingrid and Mattias begin negotiations over the December holiday schedule, with the mediator available to facilitate.

ingrid.name: Ingrid
ingrid.persona_brief:
You are Ingrid.
Ingrid wants the children for the December holidays, especially for her family's large Lucia gathering on December 13. She is aware that Mattias has a deposit on a ski trip for the first week of the break. She is on speaking terms with Mattias and has a lawyer.

mattias.name: Mattias
mattias.persona_brief:
You are Mattias.
Mattias wants the children for the first week of the December break for a ski trip he has a deposit on. He is aware of Ingrid's family's Lucia gathering. He is on speaking terms with Ingrid and has a lawyer.

mediator.name: Mediator
mediator.persona_brief:
You are Mediator.
The mediator has scheduled a final session in six weeks (by October 13, 2026). They have flagged travel dates as the only open issue between Ingrid and Mattias. They are neutral and aim to facilitate a written agreement.

resolution.question: Separated parents Ingrid and Mattias are negotiating who takes the children for the December holidays. Will they reach a written agreement before their mediator's final scheduled session in six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if a written agreement signed by both Ingrid and Mattias is recorded in the persistent event history before 2026-10-13T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
